command:
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
source_file=/etc/inventory/app.conf
destination_dir=/etc/inventory
destination_file=$destination_dir/app.conf
install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root "$destination_dir"
temporary_file=$(mktemp "$destination_dir/.app.conf.XXXXXX")
cleanup() { rm -f "$temporary_file"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
scp -q -i /etc/inventory-sync/id_ed25519 \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/etc/inventory-sync/known_hosts \
  "inventorysync@node1:$source_file" "$temporary_file"
if [ -f "$destination_file" ] && cmp -s "$temporary_file" "$destination_file"; then
  exit 0
fi
chown root:root "$temporary_file"
chmod 0644 "$temporary_file"
mv -f "$temporary_file" "$destination_file"
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  restorecon "$destination_file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
logger -t inventory-config-sync 'updated /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1'
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.service <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize inventory application configuration from node1
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SERVICE
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.timer <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_TIMER'
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize inventory application configuration every five minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=1s
RandomizedDelaySec=0
Persistent=true
Unit=inventory-config-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_SYNC_TIMER
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-config-sync.timer
systemctl start inventory-config-sync.service
systemctl is-active inventory-config-sync.timer
systemctl is-failed inventory-config-sync.service || true
sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf
systemctl list-timers inventory-config-sync.timer --no-pager
